_comment: Copy to voice-config.json and edit. Nothing reads a key from here.
The API key comes from ELEVENLABS_API_KEY or ~/.elevenlabs_key and must
never be written into this or any other file in the repository.
Only eleven_v3 and eleven_v3_conversational speak Kannada. The scripts
refuse any other model rather than producing fluent-sounding audio that
stability is a BAND on v3, not a float: creative | natural | robust.
style and speed do not exist on v3. They are recorded as editorial
intent and dropped from the request, which the generation log shows.

output_format._note: 192 kbps needs Creator or above; PCM/WAV 44.1k needs Pro.

_handle_note: Handles are interleaved silence in the scene concat lists, never padded into the line files: durations.json feeds build_timeline.py --from-audio.

targets._wpm_note: The approved Kannada script and timeline run at 93 wpm across 296.9s of speech. The brief's 100 to 110 would compress a read the edit is already built around. Measure, do not force.

rights._licence_note: ElevenLabs grants a commercial licence from Starter upward. A free plan does not carry one, and this film is screened publicly by a registered trust. Record the plan and licence with the music licence under 14 item 5.2.
rights._disclosure_note: 09 section 8 point 4 recommends one line in the end credits stating the narration is synthesised.
